app.compareNote: Sim DPS is the newest MythicSim run for each spec: 2-minute single-target fight, reference gear, no trinkets. Population is from beta samples and will change at launch.
app.dungeonNote: Enter your level to highlight dungeons around it. Dungeon XP is far below Classic, so run them for gear and quests.
facts: Included with any WoW subscription or Game Time. The Skyborne race needs an upgrade pack.
Launch 4 November at 11pm UK. No raids at launch: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open 9 December.
Two more raids are planned for spring 2027 and a revamped classic raid plus a new one for summer 2027. Molten Core isn't on the announced schedule.
Level cap 60. No flying and no level scaling. No traditional realms.
Hardcore won't be available at launch.
World buffs don't work in Forever raids.
Dungeon XP is far below Classic, so quest in the open world and run dungeons for gear.
Wands and Auto Shot need you to stand still for 0.5 sec before firing.
Early name reservation (27 October) is for players who bought an upgrade pack.
app.gearNote: Levelling picks come from the level-30 beta lists. Trinket gains are MythicSim results and differ by spec. Items marked unverified are level-60 loot whose Forever drop tables aren't confirmed yet (the beta stops at 30). "Also wanted by" shows which of your other classes would compete for the same item.
raidFacts: Onyxia's Lair keeps its Classic-style attunement chain, done per character at least at launch (Blizzard podcast, 8 October). Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit have no attunement chain, though Blizzard hints at extra steps for the full experience.
All raids are currently planned to reset each week (Blizzard raid overview, 20 October).
Every raid boss drops a chase item. Every class gets a new tier set, and the first new legendary is tied to the Hyjal Summit tier.

Crafted tier pieces are Bind on Equip and you can wear only one at launch; a Guardians of Hyjal reputation reward raises that to two, enough for the 2-piece bonus. Each needs 3 Malleable Essence of Nature, which only comes from disenchanting Barrow Deeps or Hyjal Summit items.
World buffs don't work in Forever raids. Four new Natural flasks work only in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps.
Eight group buffs became raid-wide on 15 October (Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, several totems, Moonkin Aura for spell crit, Leader of the Pack).
An epic raid item unlocks its transmog only for the player who loots it.
About 8,000 items still ship without stats, including most Tier 1 and Tier 2 pieces and later dungeon loot, so level-60 gear lists are educated guesses until launch.

app.tierNote: MythicSim reference builds, level 60, 2-minute single-target fight. The DPS shown is MythicSim's no-trinket figure; the rank follows MythicSim's order, which uses its with-trinkets headline number, so a spec can sit above one with slightly higher DPS here (Demonology above Marksmanship, Arcane above Arms, Affliction above Feral, Frostfire above Shadow, Elehance above Assassination). All 24 rows are on MythicSim's 21 Oct run (engine a667dce, client 70425). The change column is MythicSim's printed change since 16 October, not since yesterday. Bands are set from the median core spec: S is 20%+ above it, A above it, B within 15% below, C further down. Specs for the classes you're weighing are highlighted.

rules: A basic campfire holds 3 features, Journeyman 5, Expert 10.
Placing any feature starts a 60-minute cooldown on all your features. The Field Guide Legacy perk cuts it to 45 minutes.
Upgraded features come from blueprints at 140 and 300 skill.
Every feature needs a campfire nearby.
camping.summary: Build a campfire with Cooking, then place profession features around it. Sit or craft nearby for about a minute to get hour-long buffs that scale with your level. Learn it from the Camping 101 quest in your starting zone around level 5–6.

Azure Silk Hood now has a spell power variant.

New Linen and Woolen Reagent Bags for the new reagent bag slot.
Merchant's Favor from crates buys patterns.
Fishing can catch crates with bolts of cloth.

items: Normal: world PvP only when both players opt in. Easiest for mixed friend groups.
PvP: contested zones stay dangerous and levelling there is slower. One faction per account on this ruleset, with faction-balance systems like Season of Discovery.
Roleplaying: Normal rules with an RP community.
Hardcore: after launch, no date yet. Fully closed off; a dead character can transfer out.
Battlegrounds are the only place rulesets mix.
cards.title: Choosing a ruleset

checklist.text: Pick a ruleset: Normal, PvP or Roleplaying. Hardcore comes later.
checklist.why: There are no realms. You can only group, run dungeons and raid with players on your ruleset and faction, and characters can't move between rulesets.

checklist.text: Agree region, ruleset and faction with anyone you'll raid with.
checklist.why: UK players are in the Europe region and there's no cross-region play.

checklist.text: Join the Server Slam to test your UI, addons and keybinds.
checklist.why: 6pm UK. Free for anyone. Characters are wiped afterwards.

checklist.text: Pick your character name plus two backups.
checklist.why: Names are two-part and unique across the whole region. Reservation runs 27 Oct – 3 Nov and needs an upgrade pack.

checklist.text: Decide your main using the Compare tab.
checklist.why: Re-check after the last beta builds; tuning still changes weekly.
The tree opens when your first character reaches 25. Load the suggested build in the planner below.
Tailoring makes crafted tier pieces and caster gear; Enchanting pairs with it and turns raid drops into Malleable Essence.

checklist.text: Install and update addons the day before launch.
checklist.why: Many are still adding Forever support; see the list below.

checklist.text: Launch night: be logged in early.
Aim for 60 in about three weeks.
checklist.why: That leaves time for dungeon gear, gold for consumables and the Onyxia chain before raids open on 9 December.

checklist.text: Start the Onyxia attunement chain as soon as you can.
checklist.why: Per character, so every alt needs it too.

launch.summary: Things to settle before 4 November. Most can't be changed once your main exists, so do the ruleset and name first.

legacy.summary: Every character spends up to 16 points across three trees. Points come from 65 account-wide challenges, including Novice, Experienced and Master for each class, so levelling one class helps the others. Legacy unlocks when your first character reaches level 25. Your plan is saved on this device for each class.
